# Voxen Insights

Voxen Insights publishes practical Korean-language articles about applying data engineering, AI automation, trend analysis, APIs, dashboards, and business systems to real business growth.

## Core business topics
- Data collection and data engineering
- AI automation and AI agents
- Business workflow mapping and FDE delivery
- Business dashboards and APIs
- Sales, marketing and operational automation
- Custom software systems for business workflows

## Latest Articles
- [같은 질문이 매주 또 들어오나요? 문의 기록으로 FAQ·도움말 갱신 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/faq-update-from-inquiry-logs/): A practical guide to keeping FAQ and help articles current using customer inquiry logs: understanding why FAQs are organized once at launch and then drift as prices, policies and procedures change, collecting inquiries from email, web forms, chat, call notes and social messages into one format together with the agent's final answer and resolution while removing names, contact details, addresses and order numbers before analysis, using AI first to map new inquiries onto the existing FAQ list and then to group unmatched inquiries into candidate question types that people name and confirm, deciding per signal whether to write a new entry, rewrite titles in customers' own words, reconcile FAQ text with differing agent answers, archive unused entries or pass account-specific questions to self-service lookup and status notifications, drafting entries only from resolved answers and current policy documents with sources shown and gaps marked for confirmation, routing policy, refund, contract and pricing content to the owning department for approval with no automatic publishing, tagging articles by policy and product so a policy change generates a list of affected articles and reply templates, scheduling review dates, running a weekly 30-minute review, and measuring success by whether inquiries of the same type actually decline after an update.
- [월말 마감, 아직 단톡방에서 "다 끝났어요?" 묻고 계신가요? 월말 마감 체크리스트 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/month-end-close-checklist-automation/): A practical guide to automating the month-end close checklist across teams: understanding why closes slip when task lists, dependencies and progress live in people's memory and chat threads, inventorying recurring monthly, quarterly and year-end close tasks with owner, backup owner, business-day deadline, predecessor tasks, input data and a verifiable completion criterion, replacing checkboxes with automatic checks such as record counts, open unmatched items, cross-system total reconciliation and month-over-month variance where differences require a recorded reason, generating the close calendar from business days and company holidays, notifying the next owner when predecessors finish, alerting only on delays and exceptions, showing status on one close dashboard, locking closed periods with logged change requests, reviewing recurring delays to choose the next automation, and using AI only for variance summaries, exception digests and explanation drafts while people decide accounting treatment, confirm numbers and lock periods with tax questions checked by accounting or tax professionals.
- [보고서·대시보드는 늘어나는데 실제로 보는 건 몇 개뿐인가요? 안 쓰는 보고서 정리·사용 현황 관리 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/report-dashboard-inventory-cleanup/): A practical guide to cleaning up and governing business reports and dashboards: understanding why reports created for one-off requests pile up with unclear owners, near-duplicate versions, unread scheduled emails, outdated organizational criteria and growing maintenance work whenever source systems change, building one inventory across BI tools, scheduled emails, shared-folder spreadsheets and scripted extracts with purpose, owner, users, source data, refresh cycle, usage history and next review date, using view and download logs only to shortlist keep, merge, archive and retire candidates while remembering that downloaded files, screenshots and quarterly or annual reports leave little trace, retiring in reversible steps of notice, replacement links, hiding or pausing delivery, read-only archiving and logged deletion, naming one reference report per key metric, preventing regrowth with duplicate checks before new requests, required owner and review fields, monthly unused-report and orphaned-owner checks, source-change impact lists and refresh failure alerts, and using AI only for duplicate grouping, description drafts, notice drafts and pointing questions to the reference report while people decide what stays.
- [성수기 준비, 작년 매출표만 보고 계신가요? 검색어 트렌드 데이터로 수요 시기 읽기 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/search-trend-data-demand-timing/): A practical guide to reading demand timing from public search trend data: understanding why sales history misses demand lost to stockouts and shifting seasons, collecting Naver DataLab (including its official search trend API) and Google Trends data while remembering that both report relative indexes scaled to 100 within the queried period and conditions so every refresh must re-pull the full range under identical settings, defining keyword groups with variants, purchase-intent terms, excluded meanings and a stable baseline keyword, aligning weekly trends with internal orders, inquiries and on-site search, keeping only keywords with a consistent lead over sales, computing year-over-year change and slope to trigger inventory and ad-timing alerts, using AI only for keyword suggestions, on-site query classification and summaries without turning indexes into sales forecasts, and knowing limits such as search not equaling purchase, B2B repeat orders invisible to search, sparse low-volume keywords and single-platform coverage.
- [프롬프트 한 줄 고쳤는데 다른 데가 틀리기 시작했나요? AI 자동화 프롬프트 변경 관리 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/ai-prompt-change-management/): A practical guide to managing prompt changes in production AI automation: understanding why adding one rule sentence, changing tone instructions, swapping few-shot examples, editing output formats or switching model versions can silently break other cases, keeping prompts, model versions, settings, output schemas and examples together in one place with version numbers and a single pointer to the live version, recording the reason, source cases, diff, evaluation results and approver for each change, comparing old and new versions on a labeled evaluation set while checking newly failing cases and output format compatibility, rolling out with shadow runs, partial traffic or extra human review, rolling back by switching the live version instead of hot-fixing text, and separating who can draft changes from who can publish them.
- [경쟁사가 공공기관에 얼마에 납품했는지 보셨나요? 공공조달 낙찰·계약 데이터로 시장 가격과 경쟁 구도 읽기 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/public-procurement-award-data/): A practical guide to reading public procurement markets from Korean open award and contract data: understanding why bid notices show opportunities while opening results, winners and contracts show how they ended, collecting results through the official Nara Marketplace (KONEPS) open APIs and shopping mall item data instead of scraping, defining the market by work type, product and service codes, keywords, agencies and amount ranges validated against past bids, linking notice, opening, award and contract into one project record with re-notice, correction and cancellation rules, normalizing company names, computing award amount distributions, award-to-base-price ratios, bidder counts and repeat winners, listing contracts nearing expiry as early signals for recurring tenders, using AI only for project classification, company-name matching candidates and summaries that separate facts from interpretation, and knowing limits such as evaluation-weighted awards, changing recent results, contract amendments and agencies on separate systems.
- ["그 계약서 최신 버전이 뭐예요?" 아직 지난 계약서 복사해서 고치고 계신가요? 계약서 작성·검토·서명 진행 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/contract-drafting-signature-workflow/): A practical guide to automating the business contract workflow from drafting to storage: understanding why copying old contracts, emailing versions and tracking signatures in personal inboxes leaves outdated clauses and unknown status, separating approved per-type templates from variables pulled from CRM and confirmed quotes, routing internal review and approval by conditions such as modified clauses, amount thresholds, counterparty paper and personal data processing, locking the approved version before signature, tracking one contract ID through drafting, review, approval, signature request, waiting and completion with reminders, registering key terms in a contract register after signing to drive renewal alerts, billing and onboarding, confirming signature methods and template wording with legal experts, and using AI only for term extraction, deviation highlighting and change summaries while people judge legal risk and approve.
- ["status=3이 무슨 뜻이에요?" 컬럼·코드값 정의, 아직 한 사람 머릿속에만 있나요? 데이터 사전 정리 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/data-dictionary-code-values/): A practical guide to building a data dictionary for business systems: understanding why cryptic column names, undocumented code values, mixed units, ambiguous date bases, blank values and deleted or test rows silently produce wrong numbers, how a data dictionary differs from a metric definition document, the minimum fields to record per column including business name, format and unit, allowed values and code tables, meaning of blanks, source and entry timing, owner, sensitivity and change history, starting from tables actually used in reports while auto-collecting schema metadata and real code value distributions, routing column questions to the dictionary, automatically detecting schema changes, new code values, blank-rate and distribution shifts and undocumented columns while people decide meanings, and using AI only for draft descriptions, duplicate-column suggestions and dictionary search with personal data kept out of samples.
- [현장 사진, 아직 단톡방에서 찾고 계신가요? 현장 사진 AI 분류·누락 점검 자동화 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/field-photo-ai-classification/): A practical guide to organizing and checking field photos from installation, repair, inspection and construction jobs: understanding why photos lost in group chats and personal phones fail when customers, billing or disputes need them, defining a short list of required photos per job type with example shots, uploading photos directly into each job record so job number, site, technician and time are attached automatically, using rule-based checks for blur, darkness and duplicates, using AI to classify photo types and read labels and meter values with low-confidence results routed to people, warning about missing or unreadable photos at job completion while the technician is still on site, keeping quality, safety, warranty and dispute judgments with people, and limiting access and retention for photos that may show homes, faces or plates.
- [이사 수요가 많은 동네, 아직 감으로 짐작하고 계신가요? 주택 실거래·전월세 공공데이터로 지역 수요 읽기 가이드](https://insights.voxen.io/posts/housing-transaction-data-local-demand/): A practical guide to reading local moving, interior and move-in demand from Korean public housing sale and lease transaction data: collecting records through the official open API and files instead of scraping, mapping legal-dong codes to sales territories, re-querying recent months to absorb late reports and cancellations, comparing against the same month last year, using AI only for summaries and complex-name matching, never using the data to identify households, and knowing its limits.
